brand.name: Restaurante Lino
brand.tagline: Flavour, tradition and authenticity in the heart of Paredes de Coura, Castanheira

about.title: Tradition you can taste
about.p1: For generations, our family has been serving the genuine flavours of the Minho region, with recipes passed down from mother to daughter and the care of someone cooking for people they love. At Restaurante Lino, every plate is a small journey through the village cooking of Portugal — honest, generous and slowly simmered.
about.p2: We work with local producers from Paredes de Coura: Barrosã beef raised on the mountain pastures, vinho verde from the valley, wood-fired bread, and cured meats from the neighbouring houses. Everything we serve is born within a few kilometres of Castanheira.
about.p3: Sitting at Lino's table means stepping into a Portuguese home, hearing conversations around the fireplace and tasting the memory of the Minho without hurry.

dishes.title: Dishes that tell a story
dishes.subtitle: A selection of our most-loved plates, prepared at the old rhythm of the Minho.

sarrabulho.name: Arroz de Sarrabulho
sarrabulho.desc: A centuries-old Minho recipe of rice, pork and mountain spices. Served in the iron pot, straight from the fire.

bacalhau.name: Bacalhau à Lino
bacalhau.desc: Our take on oven-baked salt cod, with smashed potatoes, confit onions and valley olive oil.

posta.name: Posta Barrosã
posta.desc: Thick cut of PDO Barrosã veal, grilled over embers and served with roasted potatoes and turnip greens.

rojoes.name: Rojões à Minhota
rojoes.desc: Pork marinated in house wine, slowly fried and served with chestnuts and orange.

leiteCreme.name: Homemade Leite Creme
leiteCreme.desc: A family dessert with velvet custard, lemon peel and sugar burned at the table.

allergens.title: Allergen notice (EU Regulation No. 1169/2011)
allergens.text: If you have any food allergy or intolerance, please inform our team before placing your order. Our dishes may contain or come into contact with traces of: Gluten (bread, cornbread, alheira, brownie), Crustaceans (prawns), Eggs (desserts, breaded items), Fish (salt cod, trout), Dairy (butter, cheese, risotto, ice cream), Tree Nuts (brownie, risotto), Celery, Mustard, Sesame Seeds, Sulphur Dioxide/Sulphites (wine and vinegar in seasonings).
